task: V9.3.6.2 synthetic Pair retrieval performance A/B

environment.coldDefinition: Fresh MemoryEngine/baseDir and PairLedger caches per measured call; pre-generated identical summary JSON and Owner snapshot are reused; candidate directory construction occurs inside retrieval.
environment.warmDefinition: Same MemoryEngine, Owner snapshot and PairLedger/candidate-directory cache reused after one unmeasured priming retrieval.
environment.timingScope: retrievePairMemorySources() invocation only; fixture generation, MemoryEngine construction and Owner snapshot loading are excluded.
environment.peakMemoryDefinition: Per-call before/after RSS and heap deltas plus process.resourceUsage().maxRSS high-water value.

evidenceNotes.indexBuildCount: Raw pairIndexRebuildCount is uninstrumented/null. In this generated fixture no stored Pair index exists and all calls are readOnly with a valid date. Each measured cache miss executes buildIndex; derivedIndexBuildCount below equals intercepted readCacheMisses. This is a derived count, not an independent buildIndex probe. Supplemental indexBuildAudit directly intercepts buildIndex for all 32 candidate cells (one cold and one same-context warm each), separately from the formal wall-time samples.
evidenceNotes.candidateDirectoryBuildMs: Miss reports construction time; hit reports no rebuild (0). Fingerprinting and cache validation remain included in total retrieval wall time.
evidenceNotes.actualReadCounts: reportedIndexReadCount counts explicit retrieval reads; interceptedPairLedgerReadCount additionally includes resolveSource internal read. Both are preserved.
evidenceNotes.initialFailedAttempt: The first formal attempt was stopped at 100 Pair after warm wall samples exceeded 500ms. It is retained locally and excluded from these final samples.
